items.title: Toots Thielemans — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

ctx.x: And in that orchestra, there was Don Byas. We became good friends through [unintelligible]. I still remember the way he played the melody. Don Byas. Peanuts Holland was the trumpet [player?]. He stayed in Denmark. Many of the guys… a couple of the guys… and Billy Taylor was the young pianist. And of course, always he was very hospitable to me when I came to the States in ’51.
So winter of ’47, your first trip to America. You go back. You join up with your Belgian delegation to perform in Nice.
